level2.title: What your browser already knows about your video
level2.sub: KLARO builds on capabilities that already exist on your device. Here is what we measure and what we use it for when tuning the engine.
level2.signalDeviceDesc: Model, OS version, memory and cores. They decide whether a desktop build or a browser build makes more sense.
level2.signalGpuDesc: Real video acceleration available. If the engine can encode here, the price drops for everyone.
level2.signalAudioDesc: Sample rate and output latency. They set how far we can measure and correct in real time.
level2.signalCodecsDesc: The formats your machine can decode and encode. That is why it works without installing anything.
level2.signalScreenDesc: Resolution, color depth and gamut. They define how the corrected brightness is delivered.
level2.signalNetworkDesc: Network type and latency. If the video is heavy, we process it in chunks.
level2.signalBehaviorDesc: Which parts of the page you use and how long you stay. It tells us what to explain better.
level2.signalAnalysisDesc: The real measurements from your video, anonymous, used to tune the silence and level thresholds.
level2.privacyBody: We store your email and the technical measurements from this visit to find out whether the product helps a real person. We do not store your video, we set no tracking cookies and we do not follow you off this page. You can ask for the deletion whenever you want.

faq.title: Honest questions
faq.q1: Does it really fix badly spoken dialogue?
faq.a1: Yes: it detects silences, repetitions, stumbles and unfinished sentences, and it proposes the exact cut. The final version keeps the original audio intact and leaves the fix on a new track, so you can always compare.
faq.q2: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a2: No. The trial on this page runs inside the browser. The desktop app will be announced with the same engine, and the heavy processing stays on your machine.
faq.q3: How is brightness fixed frame by frame?
faq.a3: We measure the average luminance of every frame, detect the jumps between shots and apply a smooth compensation curve. The range is not clipped: the light is spread out.
faq.a4: It never leaves your computer. In the trial on this page it is analyzed with the browser APIs and the file is discarded when you close the tab. In the final version, processing is local by default.
faq.q5: What if the engine is not for me?
faq.a5: That is why there is a free plan with 10 credits a month and no card. If it has not saved you time in two months, you pay nothing.
faq.q6: When does the app come out?
faq.a6: Reservations are handled in order. We publish a real date once the engine passes the audio and brightness tests, not before.
